meta.name: personalize-message
meta.description: Generate a personalized outbound message (LinkedIn DM or cold email) for a single prospect by combining a template with the lead's profile, company, and recent signals. Use when the user says 'personalize this message', 'tailor this outreach to the prospect', 'rewrite this template for [name]', 'make this message more personal', or 'generate a personal opener'. Side-effecting — calls Anthropic and may pull live profile/company context via Firecrawl/Unipile/Crustdata.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为每个潜在客户生成个性化外联消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要批量生成针对不同客户的个性化邮件或领英消息
copy.tagline_en: Generate personalized outreach messages for each prospect
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to craft personalized emails or LinkedIn messages for multiple prospects

howto.what: 将你提供的草稿消息，根据单个潜在客户的个人资料、公司信息和近期动态进行个性化改写，生成一个定制版本并附改写理由和成本，但不会自动发送。
howto.when: 当你说出“个性化这条消息”、“为此潜在客户润色这段模板”等类似指令时触发。

say.text: 帮我个性化这条消息给张三，他的邮箱是zhang@email.com
say.note: Claude会先要你提供消息模板。

say.text: 用这份模板为李某改写领英私信，他的领英URL是...
say.note: Claude会验证信息并生成个性化版本。

say.text: 根据王五的资料调整这条消息，更个人化一些
say.note: Claude会提取资料并产出修改建议。

howto.what_en: Personalizes a draft message for a single prospect by merging a template with their profile, company, and recent signals; outputs the variant, reasoning, and cost—does not send it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "personalize this message", "tailor this outreach to the prospect", or similar phrases.

say_en.text: Personalize this message for John at john@example.com
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the template first.

say_en.text: Rewrite this template for Jane using her LinkedIn URL
say_en.note: Claude will validate info and generate variant.

say_en.text: Make this message more personal based on Mike's background
say_en.note: Claude pulls data and produces tailored copy.
